Verses.VerseEn: Ta, Sin, Mim. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)
These are the Verses of the Book that makes clear (the Truth).

Verses.VerseAr: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّـفۡسَكَ اَلَّا يَكُوۡنُوۡا مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Esteemed Beloved!) You will perhaps risk your (dearest) life (grieving) that they do not accept faith.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اٰيَةً فَظَلَّتۡ اَعۡنَاقُهُمۡ لَهَا خٰضِعِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: If We intend, We should send down upon them (such) a Sign from heaven as their necks would not but bow down before it.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there does not come to them any fresh direction and guidance from the Most Kind (Lord) but they turn away from it.

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوۡا فَسَيَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ اَنۡۢبٰٓـؤُا مَا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Thus they have indeed denied (the Truth), so the news of what they used to make fun of will reach them soon.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَى الۡاَرۡضِ كَمۡ اَنۡۢبَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ زَوۡجٍ كَرِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And have they not discerned the earth — what a variety of excellent vegetation We have caused to grow in it?

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً‌ ؕ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely there is a Sign in it (of Allah’s Might) but most of them are not the ones to believe.
And assuredly your Lord alone is the Almighty, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ نَادٰى رَبُّكَ مُوۡسٰىۤ اَنِ ائۡتِ الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (recall the incident) when your Lord called to Musa (Moses): ‘Go to the wrongdoing people;
(That is) the people of Pharaoh. Do they not fear (Allah)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّكَذِّبُوۡنِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) submitted: ‘O my Lord, I fear that they will reject me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَضِيۡقُ صَدۡرِىۡ وَلَا يَنۡطَلِقُ لِسَانِىۡ فَاَرۡسِلۡ اِلٰى هٰرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And my breast constricts (under such adverse circumstances) and my tongue does not express (fluently), so send (Gabriel with revelation) to Harun (Aaron as well so that he becomes my helper).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَىَّ ذَنۡۢبٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّقۡتُلُوۡنِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they also have a charge against me (of killing a Coptic), so I fear they may kill me.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ كَلَّا‌ۚ فَاذۡهَبَا بِاٰيٰتِنَآ‌ اِنَّا مَعَكُمۡ مُّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) said: ‘By no means, so go both of you with Our Signs. Surely We are with you, hearing (everything).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُوۡلَاۤ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So go both of you to Pharaoh and say: We are the Messengers (sent) by the Lord of all the worlds.
(Our aim is that) you send the Children of Israel with us (setting them free).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِيۡنَا وَلِيۡدًا وَّلَبِثۡتَ فِيۡنَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Pharaoh said: ‘Did we not bring you up among us as a child and you spent many years of your life with us?’

Verses.VerseAr: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ الَّتِىۡ فَعَلۡتَ وَاَنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (then) you committed that deed which you committed (i.e. you killed a Coptic), and you are one of the ungrateful (you have forgotten our guardianship and favours).

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَاۤ اِذًا وَّاَنَا مِنَ الضَّآلِّيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Musa [Moses]) said: ‘When I did that deed I was unaware (that even a single blow would take his life).

Verses.VerseAr: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنۡكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِىۡ رَبِّىۡ حُكۡمًا وَّجَعَلَنِىۡ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So (at that time), I went out of your (line of control) when I feared your (designs). Then my Lord bestowed on me the Commandment (of Prophethood) and (finally) made me one of the Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ اَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرآءِيۡلَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And is that (any) favour of which you are reminding me? (That happened also because) you had enslaved (all my people) the Children of Israel.’
Pharaoh said: ‘What is the Lord of all the worlds?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاؕ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Musa [Moses]) said: ‘(He) is the Lord of all the heavens and the earth and the (whole universe) between the two if you are a firm believer.’
He said to those seated around him: ‘Are you not listening?’
(Musa [Moses]) added: ‘(The One Who) is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers (too).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوۡلَـكُمُ الَّذِىۡۤ اُرۡسِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Pharaoh) said: ‘Surely your Messenger that has been sent to you is but insane.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقِ وَالۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاؕ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Musa [Moses]) said: ‘(He) is the Lord of the east and the west and (the whole universe) between the two if you have (some) sense.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَٮِٕنِ اتَّخَذۡتَ اِلٰهًا غَيۡرِىۡ لَاَجۡعَلَـنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمَسۡجُوۡنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Pharaoh) said: ‘(O Musa [Moses,]) if you take a god other than me, I will certainly (arrest and) put you among the prisoners.’
(Musa [Moses]) said: ‘Even if I bring you something manifest (also as a miracle)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَاۡتِ بِهٖۤ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Pharaoh) said: ‘Bring it if you are truthful.’
So Musa (Moses) put his staff down (on the ground) and that at once became a serpent evidently clear.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِىَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (Musa [Moses]) brought out his hand (after putting it under his armpit) and there it became radiant white to the viewers.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَاِ حَوۡلَهٗۤ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Pharaoh) said to the chiefs (sitting) around him: ‘Undoubtedly he is a (highly) learned sorcerer.

Verses.VerseAr: يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡ بِسِحۡرِهٖ‌ۖ فَمَاذَا تَاۡمُرُوۡنَ‌‏
Verses.VerseEn: He seeks to drive you out of your land by (the force of) his magic. So what is your opinion (about him now)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡۤا اَرۡجِهۡ وَاَخَاهُ وَابۡعَثۡ فِىۡ الۡمَدَآٮِٕنِ حٰشِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘Put off (the announcement of sentence for) him and his brother (Harun [Aaron]) and send callers to (all) the cities (to summon the sorcerers).
They shall bring to you every high ranking expert sorcerer.’
So all the sorcerers were assembled at the appointed time on the fixed day.
And it was said to the people (by Pharaoh’s side): ‘You will assemble together (on this occasion),

Verses.VerseAr: لَعَلَّنَا نَـتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that we may follow (Din [Religion] of) the sorcerers if they overmaster (Musa [Moses] and Harun [Aaron]).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوۡا لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ اَٮِٕنَّ لَـنَا لَاَجۡرًا اِنۡ كُنَّا نَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then when the sorcerers arrived they said to Pharaoh: ‘Is there (also) any reward (fixed) for us if we gain the upper hand (in the contest)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَاِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الۡمُقَرَّبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Pharaoh) said: ‘Yes indeed! (Instead of the rewarded ones,) you will straight away join (my) closer circle (and intimate relationship is far higher in grade than reward).’

Words.MeaningEn: the ones who are brought near

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰىۤ اَلۡقُوۡا مَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّلۡقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) said to those (sorcerers): ‘Throw down the (magic) items which you are about to throw.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَلۡقَوۡا حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُوۡا بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّا لَـنَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So they cast down their strings and sticks and said: ‘By the honour of Pharaoh we shall certainly win.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَلۡقَىٰ مُوۡسٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِىَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَاۡفِكُوۡنَ‌ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then Musa (Moses) cast down his staff which, (changing into a serpent,) began swallowing up those things which they had made look different (from reality) through trickery.
So, all the magicians fell down prostrating themselves.
They said: ‘We believe in the Lord of all the worlds,
The Lord of Musa (Moses) and Harun (Aaron).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَـكُمۡ‌ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيۡرُكُمُ الَّذِىۡ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحۡرَ‌ۚ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ‌ؕ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلٰفٍ وَّلَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Pharaoh) said: ‘You have believed in Him before I granted you permission. Surely it is he (Musa [Moses]) who is your chief (coach) and who has taught you magic. You will soon come to know (your end). I will definitely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides and will surely crucify you all.’

Words.MeaningEn: and I will surely crucify you

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا لَا ضَيۡرَ‌ اِنَّاۤ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا مُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘There is no harm (in it). Surely we are to return to our Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ لَـنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰيٰـنَاۤ اَنۡ كُنَّاۤ اَوَّلَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: We have strong hope that our Lord will forgive our sins since it is we who are the first to believe (now).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوۡسٰٓى اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِىۡۤ اِنَّكُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We revealed to Musa (Moses): ‘Take away My servants (from here) by night; you will certainly be chased.’
Then Pharaoh sent callers to the cities.
(And conveyed:) ‘Surely these (Children of Israel) are but a small party.
And undoubtedly they are provoking us.
And verily we all are (also) alert and vigilant.’
Then We drove them (Pharaoh’s people) out of gardens and springs,
And (also expelled them) from treasures and refined dwellings.
So (We did) and made the Children of Israel inheritors of all (those bounties).

Words.MeaningEn: And We caused to inherit them

Verses.VerseEn: Then at sunrise they (Pharaoh’s people) chased them.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَ الۡجَمۡعٰنِ قَالَ اَصۡحٰبُ مُوۡسٰٓى اِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when the two parties came face to face the companions of Musa (Moses) said: ‘(Now) we are sure to be caught.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ كَلَّآ‌‌ ۚ اِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّىۡ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Musa [Moses]) said: ‘Never! Surely my Lord is with me. He will show me the way (to deliverance) just now.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوۡسٰٓى اَنِ اضۡرِبْ بِّعَصَاكَ الۡبَحۡرَ‌ؕ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٍ كَالطَّوۡدِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We revealed to Musa (Moses): ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ So the sea split (into twelve parts) and each part became like a huge mountain.
And We brought the other party (Pharaoh and his companions) closer to that place.
And We saved Musa (Moses) and (also) all those who were with him.
Then We drowned the others (i.e. Pharaoh and his people).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً‌ ؕ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely in this (incident) there is a great Sign (of Allah’s Infinite Power). And most of them were not the believers.
And verily your Lord alone is Almighty, Ever-Merciful indeed.
And also recite to them the story of Ibrahim (Abraham).

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ مَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When he said to his father and his people: ‘What do you worship?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا نَـعۡبُدُ اَصۡنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘We worship idols and remain stuck to their (worship and care).’
(Ibrahim [Abraham]) said: ‘Do they hear you when you call (them)?
Or do they bring you any profit or loss?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘(We do not know that) but we found our fathers doing the same.’
(Ibrahim [Abraham]) said: ‘Have you (ever) thought (of their reality) you worship?’
(Did) you or (any of) your forefathers (ever realize)?

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوٌّ لِّىۡۤ اِلَّا رَبَّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So (all) these (idols) are enemies to me except the Lord of all the worlds. (He is the One Who is my God.)
He Who created me and He is the One Who guides me.
And He is the One Who provides me with food and drink.
And when I fall ill, He is the One Who cures me.
He is the One Who will cause me to die and then He alone will give me life (again),

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِىۡۤ اَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ لِىۡ خَطِٓیْئـَٔـتِىۡ يَوۡمَ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Who, I hope, will forgive me my misdeeds on the Day of Judgment.

Verses.VerseAr: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِىۡ حُكۡمًا وَّاَلۡحِقۡنِىۡ بِالصّٰلِحِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O my Lord! Bless me with excellence in knowledge and deeds, and include me among those who deserve Your exceptional intimacy.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاجۡعَلْ لِّىۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And ordain for me virtuous remembrance and acceptance among the coming generations (too).
And include me among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاغۡفِرۡ لِاَبِىۡۤ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And forgive my father. Surely he was of the misguided.
And disgrace me not on the Day (when) people will be raised up (from the graves),

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنۡفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when neither wealth nor sons will profit.

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا مَنۡ اَتَى اللّٰهَ بِقَلۡبٍ سَلِيۡمٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But he alone (will be the gainer) who appears before the Presence of Allah with a heart protected (from) and pure (of all evils).’
And (on that Day) Paradise will be brought closer to the Godfearing (and self-protecting).
And Hell will be uncovered before the misguided.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَيۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And it will be said to them: ‘Where are those (idols) which you used to worship,

Verses.VerseAr: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ هَلۡ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَكُمۡ اَوۡ يَنۡتَصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Besides Allah? Can they help you or can they help themselves (to save themselves from Hell)?’
So into Hell will be thrown headlong (the idols as well as) the people who lost the straight road.
And all the troops of Iblis (too will be hurled into Hell).
Those (misguided people) will say while disputing among themselves (in the Hell):

Verses.VerseAr: تَاللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنَّا لَفِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: ‘By Allah, we were in manifest error,
When we held you equal to the Lord of all the worlds.
And no other than (these) evildoers led us astray.
So we do not have any intercessor (today).
Nor do we have any passionate friend.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَوۡ اَنَّ لَـنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Alas! If once we could have (a chance to) return (to the world), we would become believers.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً‌ ؕ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely in this (incident) there is a great Sign (of Allah’s Infinite Power). And most of them were not the believers.
And verily your Lord alone is Almighty, Ever-Merciful.
The people of Nuh (Noah also) rejected the Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ نُوۡحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When their (kinship) brother Nuh (Noah) said to them: ‘Do you not fear (Allah)?
Indeed I (have come as) a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَسۡــَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ‌ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I do not demand of you any wages for this (preaching of the Truth). My reward is only with the Lord of all the worlds.
So fear Allah and obey me.’
They said: ‘Should we believe in you while the people of the lowest and most worthless (classes of society) are following you?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِىۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Nuh [Noah]) said: ‘What has my knowledge to do with their (professional) tasks?

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّىۡ‌ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Their account is only with my Lord. If you could but understand (what the real honour and dishonour is)!
And I am not the one who casts out the believers.
I am only a clear Warner.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا لَٮِٕنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ يٰـنُوۡحُ لَـتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمَرۡجُوۡمِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘O Nuh (Noah), if you do not stop (saying these things), then surely you will be stoned to death.’
(Nuh [Noah]) submitted: ‘O my Lord, my people have rejected me.

Verses.VerseAr: فَافۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِىۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحًا وَّنَجِّنِىۡ وَمَنۡ مَّعِىَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So judge between me and them and deliver me and the believers who are in my company.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعَهٗ فِىۡ الۡـفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We delivered him and those who were (aboard) with him in the fully loaded Ark.
Then thereafter We drowned all the rest.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً‌ ؕ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely in this (incident) there is a great Sign (of Allah’s Infinite Power) and most of them were not the believers.
And verily your Lord alone is Almighty, Ever-Merciful.
(The people of) ‘Ad (too) rejected the Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ هُوۡدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When their (kinship) brother Hud said to them: ‘Do you not fear (Allah)?
Verily I (have come as) a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَسۡـَٔـلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ‌ اِنۡ اَجۡرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I do not demand of you any wages for this (preaching of the Truth). My reward is only with the Lord of all the worlds.
Do you build a monument on every high point (merely) for vanity and vain pursuits?
And do you erect strongly-built palaces (having pools) with the hope of living (in the world) forever?
And when you lay hand on someone you do it like ruthless tyrants.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And fear Him (Allah) Who has helped you with the things which you know.
He has helped you with cattle and children,
And (also) with gardens and springs.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely I fear the torment of a Terrible Day coming upon you.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَاۤ اَوَعَظۡتَ اَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡوٰعِظِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘It is all the same to us whether you admonish or do not become of those who admonish (we shall not believe).
It is nothing (else) but the habits (and customs) only of the forerunners (which we cannot abandon).
And we will not be afflicted with the torment.

Verses.VerseAr: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَهۡلَـكۡنٰهُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً‌ ؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So they rejected him (Hud) and We destroyed them. Surely in this (incident) there is a great Sign (of Allah’s Infinite Power) and most of them were not the believers.
And verily your Lord alone is Almighty, Ever-Merciful.
(The people of) Thamud (also) rejected the Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When Salih, their (kinship) brother, said to them: ‘Do you not fear (Allah)?
Verily I (have come as) a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَسۡــَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ‌ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I do not demand of you any wages for this (preaching of the Truth). My reward is only with the Lord of all the worlds.
Will you be left in peace and contentment (forever) in these (bounties) which are (available to you) here?
(Here) in the gardens and springs?
And in crops and palm-trees which have soft and fine blossoms?
And, skilled (in stone-carving), you carve out houses in the mountains.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And do not obey the instructions of those who exceed limits,

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ يُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who spread destructive activities in the land and do not do constructive works (for society).’
They said: ‘You are but of the magic-stricken people.

Verses.VerseAr: مَاۤ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَا‌ ۖۚ فَاۡتِ بِاٰيَةٍ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: You are but a human being like us, so bring some Sign if you are truthful.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرۡبٌ وَّلَـكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Salih) said: ‘(That Sign) is this she-camel. A time for water is (appointed) for her and on an appointed day is your turn for water.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡهَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَيَاۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do not touch her with evil (intention) or the torment of a (gravely) terrible Day will seize you.’
But they hamstrung her (and killed her). Then they became remorseful (because of what they did).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً‌ ؕ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So the torment seized them. Surely in this (incident) there is a great Sign and most of them were not the believers.
And verily your Lord alone is Almighty, Ever-Merciful.
(The people of) Lut (Lot) also rejected the Messengers,

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ لُوۡطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When Lut (Lot), their (kinship) brother, said to them: ‘Do you not fear (Allah)?
Verily I (have come as) a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ‌ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I do not demand of you any wages for this (preaching of the Truth). My reward is only with the Lord of all the worlds.
Do you approach only males (to satisfy your sexual desire) from among the people of the world;

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَذَرُوۡنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَـكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَزۡوَاجِكُمۡ‌ؕ بَلۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عٰدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you leave your wives your Lord has created for you? You are rather of those who exceed bounds (in transgression).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا لَٮِٕنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ يٰلُوۡطُ لَـتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُخۡرَجِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘O Lut (Lot), if you do not stop (saying these things), you will surely become of the exiled.’
(Lut [Lot]) said: ‘No doubt I am of those who are disgusted by your practice.
O Lord! Deliver me and my family from (the consequent suffering of) this practice which they are doing.’
So We delivered him and his entire family,
Except for an old woman who was among those who stayed behind.
Then We destroyed the others.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّطَرًا‌ۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We rained on them (stones). So how devastating was that rain on the people who were stressed with horror!

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً‌ ؕ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely in this (incident) there is a great Sign and most of them were not the believers.
And verily your Lord alone is Almighty, Ever-Merciful.
The dwellers of al-Aika (i.e. the People of the Wood also) rejected the Messengers,

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When Shu‘aib said to them: ‘Do you not fear (Allah)?
Verily I (have come as) a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ‌ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِىَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I do not demand of you any wages for this (preaching of the Truth). My reward is only with the Lord of all the worlds.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوۡفُوۡا الۡـكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُخۡسِرِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Always fill up full measure and do not become injurious (to the rights of the people).
And weigh with a straight balance.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do not give to the people their things (weighing) less than what is due, nor provoke strife in the land (by such moral, economic and social corruption and fraud).
And fear Him (Allah) Who has created you and the former generations.’
They said: ‘(O Shu‘aib,) you are but of the magic-stricken people.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُـنَا وَاِنۡ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you are but a human being like us and surely we consider you among the liars.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, make a piece of heaven fall on us, if you are truthful.’
(Shu‘aib) said: ‘My Lord knows best these (frauds) which you are doing.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ الظُّلَّةِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So they rejected Shu‘aib and the torment of the Day of Shadow seized them. No doubt that was the torment of a terrible day.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً‌ ؕ وَّمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely in this (incident) there is a great Sign and most of them were not the believers.
And verily your Lord alone is Almighty, Ever-Merciful.
And indeed this Qur’an has been revealed by the Lord of all the worlds.
The Trusted Spirit (Gabriel) has descended with it,
Upon your (most illumined) heart so that you may be a Warner (to the disobedient).
(It is sent down) in the plain Arabic language.
And verily it is (also mentioned) in the scriptures of former communities.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهُمۡ اٰيَةً اَنۡ يَّعۡلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰٓؤُا بَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرآءِيۡلَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And is it not for them a (sufficient) proof (of the Truth of the Qur’an and the Truth of Muhammad’s Prophethood [blessings and peace be upon him]) that the learned scholars of the Children of Israel (also) recognize it?
And if We had sent it down to any of the non-Arabs,

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And he had recited it to these people, (even then) they would not have believed in it.
Thus have We forced its (denial) firmly into the hearts of the sinners.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰى يَرَوُا الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.
So that (torment) will come upon them all of a sudden and they will not (even) perceive it.

Words.MeaningEn: And it will come to them

Verses.VerseEn: They will then say: ‘Shall we be given respite?’
Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?

Words.MeaningEn: So is it for Our punishment

Verses.VerseEn: Tell Me, if We provide them benefit for years,
Then comes to them that (torment) which they are being promised,

Verses.VerseAr: مَاۤ اَغۡنٰى عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يُمَتَّعُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then what will those resources which they were utilizing do (to drive that torment away from them)?

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنۡذِرُوۡنَ‌‌‌‌‌ ۛ‌ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not destroyed any town except those (towns) for which Warners had come,
(And that too) for direction and guidance. And We were not unjust.
And it is not Satans who descended with this (Qur’an).
They are neither worthy nor capable (of it).
Surely they have been debarred from hearing (this Divine Communication).

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُعَذَّبِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, (O My servant,) do not call upon any other god besides Allah lest you become of those who are punished.
And, (O Esteemed Beloved,) warn your close relatives (of Our torment).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And extend your (merciful, kind and supporting) hand to those believers who follow you.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ اِنِّىۡ بَرِىۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But, if they disobey you, then say: ‘I am disgusted by these (evil) deeds which you are doing.’
And put your trust in Almighty, Ever-Merciful (Lord),
Who sees you when you stand up (for Tahajjud Prayer in the solitary hours at night),
And Who (also keeps) seeing your turning movements among those who prostrate themselves in Prayer.
Verily He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: هَلۡ اُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلٰى مَنۡ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰـطِيۡنُؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Shall I tell you upon whom the satans descend?
They descend on every lying sinner (who weaves false allegations),
Who pour (into their ears) hearsay and most of them are liars.
And only the digressers follow the poets.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّهُمۡ فِىۡ كُلِّ وَادٍ يَّهِيۡمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you not seen that these (poets) wander distracted (purposelessly) in every valley (of reflections? They take little serious and true interest in reality. They rather remain happy and lost in verbal leaps and imaginative jumps).
And that they say (such things) that they do not (themselves) do,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوۡا اللّٰهَ كَثِيۡرًا وَّانْتَصَرُوۡا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُوۡا‌ؕ وَسَيَـعۡلَمُ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡۤا اَىَّ مُنۡقَلَبٍ يَّـنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except for those (poets) who believe and do pious deeds persistently and remember Allah abundantly (i.e. they eulogize Allah and the Holy Prophet [blessings and peace be upon him] in their poetry), and avenge themselves after they are wronged (by means of poetic compositions, and defend Islam and the oppressed rather inspire them with zeal through their poetry. This type of poetry is not condemnable.) And those who do wrong will soon come to know to what place of turning they shall turn back (after death).
